info.description:
Localize Python source between human languages over HTTP.

The Legesher Bridge API runs the open-source [Legesher](https://legesher.io)
engine. It rewrites Python's own words in another human language, reads the
language packs, gathers the facts for explaining code in a language, and
statically checks files, translated or not.

**Privacy.** Submitted source is never logged and never used for training.

**Versioning.** Every route lives under `/v1`. The versioning and deprecation
policy is at https://docs.legesher.io/api/versioning/.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Keys are created
on the keys page at https://app.legesher.io, or by device sign-in
(`/v1/oauth/*`, RFC 8628) from a command line or editor. `/v1/health` and the
`/v1/languages*` listing need no key. `/v1/translate`, `/v1/translate/snippet`,
`/v1/validate` and `/v1/explain` also answer a caller without a key, on a small
anonymous trial. `/v1/me` requires a key; `/v1/map` and enhanced translation
require a paid plan.

**Limits and usage.** Responses from those routes, success and error alike,
carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`/`-Remaining`/`-Reset` and
`X-Usage-Characters-Used`/`-Remaining`. A request refused before the caller is
identified does not, and a plan with no limit leaves the matching set out. Every response
carries `X-Request-ID`.
A request over a limit gets `429` (there is no metered overage); only a
successfully served request is billed.

**Errors** use one envelope, `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`, that never
contains filesystem paths, stack traces, or submitted source.

Guides and this reference: https://docs.legesher.io/api/.
info.title: Legesher Bridge API

Deactivate the presented token. Always 200 with a uniform body.

active, already revoked, or never existed, so revocation cannot be used
to test whether a key is valid. Works for any API key, not only ones
created by device sign-in (they are the same credential): this is how
a command line signs out.

(keep polling), ``slow_down`` (add 5 seconds to the interval; a poll
that comes too early also restarts the wait), ``expired_token`` /
``access_denied``
(terminal: restart the flow), ``invalid_grant`` (unknown, malformed, or
already-redeemed code).
